say:1:1620610001:0.text: Thanks! And whoa, that spell looked like something a senior professor would cast!
say:1:1620610001:0.source_cn: 谢了啊！你的魔法简直是老师级的！
say:1:1620610001:0.male: Thanks! And whoa, that spell looked like something a senior professor would cast!
say:1:1620610001:0.female: Thanks! And whoa, that spell looked like something a senior professor would cast!

say:3:1620610004:1.text: Name's Banksee. I came looking for a friend!
say:3:1620610004:1.source_cn: 我叫班克西，是来找我朋友的！
say:3:1620610004:1.male: Name's Banksee. I came looking for a friend!
say:3:1620610004:1.female: Name's Banksee. I came looking for a friend!

say:5:1620610005:0.text: You don't mean me... do you? And why are you even here at this odd hour?
say:5:1620610005:0.source_cn: 呼……你说的朋友不会是我吧……？话说你怎么这个时间在这？

say:6:1620610006:0.text: Of course I mean you, Loran! Are you alright? I thought those books had carried you off to Dura-knows-where!
say:6:1620610006:0.source_cn: 当然是你啊！洛兰！你没事吧！我还以为你早就被那群魔法书...

say:7:1620610007:0.text: I've been hiding near the classroom this whole time... What about you? Why are you even here?
say:7:1620610007:0.source_cn: 我……我刚才一直躲在教室附近。你在这干什么？

say:8:1620610008:0.text: Well, actually... I came here to prank you.

say:10:1620610010:0.text: You've been buried in books for days, no sleep, no food... Keep that up and you'll fry your brain!
say:10:1620610010:0.source_cn: 你这家伙整天窝在自习室里，不吃不睡的学魔法，人都会学傻的！

say:11:1620610011:0.text: I figured I'd scare you a little, get your head out of the textbooks... but the moment I stepped into the hall, I got swarmed by flying books!
say:11:1620610011:0.source_cn: 我想搞点小恶作剧，把你的魂从书本上拽回来一点……结果刚...

say:13:1620610013:1.text: You didn't even realize, did you?
say:13:1620610013:1.source_cn: 哈，我就知道你自己什么都没意识到。

say:14:1620610014:1.text: Still, credit where it's due—you really nailed that scolding voice. It sounded like a real angry professor if I've ever heard one.
say:14:1620610014:1.source_cn: 不过你的恶作剧手段变这么高明了？那些训斥声，学得还挺像...

say:15:1620610015:1.text: Scolding voice? What are you talking about? That wasn't me.

say:16:1620610016:1.text: Hold on... actually, yeah. I did hear someone barking reprimands when I got here. I thought I was imagining it.
say:16:1620610016:1.source_cn: 说起来……我刚到这附近的时候，好像听见过几句奇怪的训斥...

say:17:1620610017:1.text: Hey, you were not trying to turn the prank around on me, were you? Nice try!
say:17:1620610017:1.source_cn: 嘿，说真的，你不会想将计就计，整蛊我一下吧？哈，我可不...

say:19:1620610019:1.text: No? Then who was it? A ghost?
say:19:1620610019:1.source_cn: 没有？那还能是幽灵发出的不成？

say:20:1620610020:1.text: Alright, so it wasn't your prank, and it wasn't my imagination...
say:20:1620610020:1.source_cn: 也就是说那声音不是你装出来的，也不是我的幻听……

say:21:1620610021:0.text: Alright, alright, enough! I give up, okay?
say:21:1620610021:0.source_cn: 别、别闹了，哈哈……算我输了还不行？

say:26:1620610023:0.text: The scolding voice breaks the silence of the night. It echoes from some unseen corner, laced with a chilling authority that makes your skin crawl.
say:26:1620610023:0.source_cn: 训斥声在寂静的夜空下回荡，仿佛从某个看不见的角落传来，...

say:27:1620610024:1.text: The magic books around you suddenly stir, their pages fluttering like wings. As if jolted awake by the voice, they break free and surge forward, disappearing into the shadows.
say:27:1620610024:1.source_cn: 魔法书像被那声音唤醒般齐齐扇动翅页，挣脱停滞，朝走廊深...

say:29:1620610025:0.text: Banksee's face goes pale. His eyes widen with sudden realization. He drops into a crouch, wraps his arms around his knees, and curls up tight in the corner, frozen in place.
say:29:1620610025:0.source_cn: 班克西脸色一变，像是突然意识到了什么，整个人猛地蜷缩起...

choice:2:0:1.text: Yeah? I'm the one who taught the professors.
choice:2:0:1.male: Yeah? I'm the one who taught the professors.
choice:2:0:1.female: Yeah? I'm the one who taught the professors.

say:32:1620610002:0.text: Ha! Yeah, that's got to be it. Looks younger than I expected, but everything else fits the story!
say:32:1620610002:0.source_cn: 哈，没错！除了长得年轻了点以外，其他特征都没什么问题！
say:32:1620610002:0.male: Ha! Yeah, that's got to be it. Looks younger than I expected, but everything else fits the story!
say:32:1620610002:0.female: Ha! Yeah, that's got to be it. Looks younger than I expected, but everything else fits the story!

say:33:1620610003:0.text: Anyway, you saved my neck back there! I owe you. Drinks are on me next time!
say:33:1620610003:0.source_cn: 不管怎么说，我这张脸算是你救的！回头请你喝一杯！
say:33:1620610003:0.male: Anyway, you saved my neck back there! I owe you. Drinks are on me next time!
say:33:1620610003:0.female: Anyway, you saved my neck back there! I owe you. Drinks are on me next time!

choice:2:1:2.text: What are you doing over there?
choice:2:1:2.male: What are you doing over there?
choice:2:1:2.female: What are you doing over there?
